records.Concise description: An Ordinals avocado-themed collection linked by on-chain historical documentation to Bitcoin Shroom #679 and still used in current Ordinals community distribution experiments.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitcoin Bravocados is an avocado-themed Ordinals collection whose on-chain TorchHub history entry links the collection by parent-child provenance to Bitcoin Shroom #679 and describes a commonly reported association with ZK Shark. That wording does not provide strong enough first-party evidence to lock ZK Shark as creator. Current 2026 Ordinals community reporting documents Bravocados still being distributed through Parasite Pool activity, which is sufficient to establish ongoing project/ecosystem operation. MSC therefore upgrades lifecycle status to ACTIVE while keeping source confidence LOW and creator attribution provisional.
Creators / founders: Creator / artist not first-party verified; ZK Shark is associated in on-chain historical accounts but attribution remains provisional
records.Launch / history: Ordinals-era collection; precise launch chronology requires first-party confirmation.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: The project reflects early Ordinals remix/meme culture and an apparent lineage connection to Bitcoin Shrooms.
Important technical or cultural characte: Parent-child relationship to Bitcoin Shroom #679 documented in on-chain history
records.Verification basis: On-chain TorchHub history for the Shroom #679 parent-child relationship plus current 2026 ecosystem reporting documenting active Bravocados distribution; no authoritative creator-controlled source located.
Research notes / uncertainties: ZK Shark attribution remains provisional because the on-chain historical entry itself uses qualified wording rather than a creator-controlled statement.
Exact supply is not locked and should not be published without stronger first-party/on-chain collection-scope evidence.
ACTIVE status reflects documented current distribution/use, not secondary-market trading.

records.Concise description: An early original-art 10k Ordinals collection that began inscribing before NodeMonkes but completed later.
records.Deeper researched summary: Honey Badgers is important for both early 10k inscription chronology and its still-active community. Historical research places its first inscription before NodeMonkes, while NodeMonkes completed its full original-art 10k first. The Honey Badgers project account remained active in 2026 and directly identifies Akva556 and DesenhistaRedn, so MSC classifies the project ACTIVE rather than treating a completed mint as automatically historical.
records.Launch / history: Began inscribing in the early 10k-collection period in 2023; completion extended well beyond the earliest inscription range.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: It is central to correctly explaining the 'first original-art 10k' chronology and prevents misleading winner-take-all historical claims.
Important technical or cultural characte: Chronology distinction: first to begin vs first to finish
